title: Certified AI & Digital Assets Engineer For Developers | Saylani Mass IT Training
text: Course: Certified AI & Digital Assets Engineer For Developers. Category: Development. Duration: 10 months. Description: Produces smart-contract and agent engineers for regulated environments, covering blockchain, AI engineering, security/audit, and compliance/Shariah topics. This course is offered free of cost by Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT), an initiative of Saylani Welfare International Trust. Admission is via the online registration form at https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll, selecting this course and a preferred campus/city.
